---
description: Make sure implementation work belongs to an issue before starting it.
applyTo: "**"
---

# Work belongs to an issue

- Before implementation work starts, make sure it belongs to an issue. Implementation work means changing files, creating branches, or changing GitHub state. Chat, questions, research, and reviews don't need an issue.
- If the request, branch, or pull request doesn't name an issue, ask which one the work belongs to. Search for likely matches first and offer them. If none fits, offer to draft a minimal issue with `fusion-issue-authoring`.
- If the user chooses to continue without an issue, respect that, and note the missing link in the delivery report.
- In autopilot, link a clearly matching issue. If there is none, draft one locally without publishing it, and report it.
- Carry the issue reference into branch names, commits, and pull requests as the repository's conventions require.
